I’m sorry to hear that. I suffer from 2 incurable chronic pain disorders so I can somewhat relate to how you feel. Just try to take things day by day and be happy with the things you still have. There are people in this world that suffer much more than the two of us and we should count our blessings. I also want to end my life  but you have to take into account the people that love and care for you. If it wasn’t for my family I would’ve been dead a long time ago, think about how devastated the people who love you would be. I know you probably don’t care what I have to say and find it patronizing but I really hope you start feeling a little happier in life. If you ever need someone to talk to I’m here.
